body:
## Modern Dev Tools

A modern overhaul of RimWorld's developer tools (Modern Suite). Namespace `ModernDevTools`, assembly `ModernDevTools.dll`, packageId `astryl.ModernDevTools`. C# + Harmony.

### Documentation (`Documentation/`)
- `RootCauseAnalysis.md` — AUTHOR guide: how to teach MDT about your mod's errors (the 3 contribution paths — KnownIssueDef XML, community `known-issues.json`, C# ErrorModule — sharing one match model). This file is the house documentation style (markdown, plain-language tables, sentence case, ASCII, H1 + italic subtitle).
- `Subsystems.md` — PLAYER guide (added this pass): a tour of every subsystem in MDT's house style. Grouped as the three windows / error analysis (impact banner + the 6 modules in run order 10-45) / community knowledge + reporting / save safety / experimental hardening, plus an at-a-glance always-on vs opt-in vs experimental table. Each row uses a What-it's-doing / What-you-see / On-by-default shape.

### Shared UI (`Palette`)
Dark suite chrome, no `GameFont.Tiny`, sentence case, ASCII, cached Theme.Accent, flat gray scrollbars (`Palette.BeginScroll`/`EndScroll`). Shipped icons in `Textures/UI/DevTools/` via `MdtTex`: thumbtack `Pin`, `Chevron`, and a themed `Close` X used by `Palette.CloseX` (line fallback).

### Tool 1: modern debug log (`Window_ModernLog`)
Redirects `UIRoot.CheckOpenLogWindow` + `DebugWindowsOpener.ToggleLogWindow`. Left list (culled) + right inspector. Full parity + Modules button, Ignore, mod links, Update info button, Mods-changed indicator. Inspector leads with an **impact banner** (`ImpactAssessor`), and (for errors/warnings) ends with a **Report to the community** card before the stack trace.

### Analysis modules
`ErrorModuleDef`/`ErrorModule`/`ModernDevToolsAPI` + `ErrorContext` (ranks mods, collects diagnoses, cached per message). Built-ins (run order): `Module_StackTrace` (10), `Module_MessageMentions` (20), `Module_VersionMismatch` (25, LOCAL), `Module_KnownIssues` (30, ~32-entry shipped library, ignorable), `Module_Community` (40, RimSort rules + Use This Instead), `Module_CommunityBugs` (45, our own bug DB). `Module_StackTrace` attributes frames via assembly resolution + namespace-ownership fallback (`FrameParser`).

### Community data (opt-in, `CommunityData`)
Off by default; enable + Update info fetches on a background thread, caches to config folder (embedded `Json`, gzip), offline fallback, per-mod lookups. Sources: RimSort Community Rules, Use This Instead, and our own `known-issues.json`. `RepoOwner`/`RepoName` consts (`Astryls`/`ModernDevTools-KnownIssues`) drive both the fetch URL and the reporting URLs.

### Our community bug database + in-game reporting API (Option A: GitHub Issue Forms)
Contributor-editable JSON on GitHub, matched by exception type / keywords / regex / namespace / packageId -> explanation + fix + credit, ranks above generic advice, marks Known. **Reporting is server-less and secret-free** — the mod never holds a write token; the user submits the issue under their own GitHub account.

**In-game composer (`Dialog_Report`, `Source/Community/Dialog_Report.cs`).** The report card's two buttons now open this dialog instead of jumping straight to the browser — this is the "add information before pushing" step:
- Read-only auto-collected block (exception, RimWorld version, implicated packageIds, signature).
- Editable fields — **Bug** mode: "what were you doing"; **Fix** mode: explanation + "how did you fix it?" + optional credit.
- **Live preview** of the exact text that will be copied/submitted.
- Buttons: **Copy report** (clipboard, explicit + obvious), **Open on GitHub** (pre-filled Issue Form + clipboard), **Close**. Nothing leaves the game until the user chooses.

**`ReportBuilder`** builds the pre-filled Issue Form URLs and the report text: `ReportBug(msg,a,summary)`, `SubmitFix(msg,a,explanation,fix,credit)`, `FullReport`/`FullReportWithNote`, plus public `Signature`/`ExceptionType`/`Implicated`/`SafeVersion` the dialog displays. **Signature** = FNV-1a over exception type + normalized top-6 frame *types* (`FrameParser.QualifiedTypeOf`; method names/IL offsets/paths dropped so it's identical across machines), shown as `[#xxxxxxxx]` in the issue title for dedup. URL kept under a ~6 KB budget (trims/drops `details`). Query-param names are the contract with the Issue Forms' field `id`s. `AlreadyKnown` flips the card to "already in database / add detail".

**Repo side** (staged in `_dev/ModernDevTools/community-db/`, mirrors the repo root): `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug-report.yml`, `fix-submission.yml`, `config.yml`; `.github/workflows/community-db.yml` (fix-submission → parse → validated entry → PR via `peter-evans/create-pull-request`; report → dedupe by `[#signature]`; ensures labels; default `GITHUB_TOKEN` only); `known-issues.schema.json`, `known-issues.json` seed, `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

### Tool 2: dev actions window (`Window_ModernDevActions`, 3-tab)
Reuses the vanilla `DebugActionNode` graph (`DebugTree` reads `Dialog_Debug.roots` after `TrySetupNodeGraph`) so every vanilla AND mod-added debug action appears automatically. Categories grouped contiguously via vanilla `TrySort` (`DebugActionCategories.GetOrderFor`). Thumbtack pins, texture chevrons, spawn icon grid, dev-action fallback icon, per-call hardening.
- **Search is recursive + cached (`SearchResults`)** — searches the *whole current tab from its root* (descending into categories/submenus up to depth 4, guarded to ≤300 results / 8000 iterations, cached per (tab, search) so it runs on a keystroke, not per frame). Previously it only filtered the current node's direct children.

#### Testing debug actions (`DebugActions_Testing`)
Dev-only `[LudeonTK.DebugAction]` methods under category **"Modern Dev Tools"** (`Entry` + `Playing`) that emit test log entries: **Log test message / warning / error**, **Throw test exception** (real nested throw through `ThrowInner`, caught + `Log.Error`'d so the stack trace runs through our types → attributes to us + real signature), **Log burst (mixed)**, **Log repeated error x5**. A `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]` registers the category in `DebugActionCategories.categoryOrders` (order 50) so it sorts to the **TOP** of the Actions tab (unregistered mod categories default to `int.MaxValue`/bottom — why they first looked "missing"). **Palette-pin gotcha:** a flat DebugAction's node `Path` is `Actions\<label>` (category is display-only, NOT a path segment), so palette pins use `Actions\<label>`.

### Tool 3: dev palette (`Window_ModernDevPalette`)
Reskins `Dialog_DevPalette`.

### Updated-mod tracking + update notes
`GameComponent_ModSnapshot` diffs the save's mods vs current -> Mods-changed indicator -> `Dialog_ModChanges`. `Dialog_UpdateNotes` shown once per `ModernDevToolsMod.Version`.

### Experimental hardening (two toggles, both off by default)
Toggles in Mod settings and the Modules pop-out. 1. **Window hardening** (`WindowWatchdog`). 2. **World/map UI hardening** (`UiHardening`) finalizers on world/map/global-controls OnGUI surfaces.

### Localization
`Languages/English/Keyed/ModernDevTools.xml` (`MDT_*`, incl. `MDT_Report*`, `MDT_SubmitFix*`, `MDT_FixField_*`, `MDT_ReportInfo_*`); Def label/description DefInjected-translatable.
